Definition: (only in the plural and with the article) the Berites, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Berites = "my well: of the well"; 1) a tribe who are named with Abel and Beth-maachah, and who were therefore doubtless situated in the north of Palestine
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
